name: rbh-sales-crm
description: RBH Sales CRM — one project: Express API + React (Vite) frontend, served from a single Node process in production.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev:bare" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:local-db: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start:serve-client: cross-env SERVE_CLIENT=true npm --prefix backend run dev:bare
